victim.name: Macheret Alexey
victim.address: mun. Chisinau, str. A. Doga, 30, ap.38

perpetrator.name: Dulcea Victor Grigore
perpetrator.organization: Ministry of Internal Affairs of RM

torture_methods.name: SWALLOW
torture_methods.description: Handcuffs tied to ankles, victim lies in wheel position

torture_methods.name: CROWBAR
torture_methods.description: Stick through swallow, stretches shoulder joint tendons

torture_methods.name: GAS MASK
torture_methods.description: Old gas mask WITHOUT filter for unbearable suffering

goal_of_torture: Force confession to theft of welding machine (which he did NOT commit)
consequences: Staphylococcus aureus infection on both ankles
Removal of two veins on the left leg
Tendon rupture on right hand - surgery required
Could not walk for several months

legal_qualification.article_17_rome_statute: State organs that HID and FAILED TO INVESTIGATE the fact of torture - cover-up of torture by government authorities
